lines.t: You shape the wind that whispers low The rivers sing where waters flow
The stars above, they know your name And I, I stand in awe
The same
You made me, you made the skies
Every tear, every sunrise
You are the breath, the truth, the flame
Yahushua, forever your name
Forever your name
Mountains rise where your voice calls
Even shadows bow in holy halls
You turned my heart on stone to clay
Now I'm alive
You lit the way
Through the storm, through the fight
You are my morning, my endless light
You made me, you made the skies
Every tear, every sunrise
You are the breath, the truth, the flame
Yahushua, forever your name
When I was lost, you found me there In the quiet, in the prayer
You broke the chains, you set me free I wish you were you
Oh, I see
We'll be right back.
